messages:
zoe_finance: Received a reseller dispute — Azure invoice shows billing for 140 seats but partner export reconciles to 118. They claim a CSV backfill was pushed that backdated events without event_time. Can we triage quickly?

sam_partners: Oof. Which invoice/sub?

zoe_finance: invoice INV-2026-12-09-res-210, sub res-210. Invoice created 2026-12-01 snapshot. Partner says they pushed a backfill on 2026-12-03 and omitted event_time, only ingest_time present.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-12-09-res-210 generated for $5,040.00 (140 seats @ $36). Billing period: 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31.

henry_billing: If ingest_time was used as event_time we could have retroactively counted those seats into the 12/01 snapshot. Need raw CSV and connector logs.

ingest-bot: Created ticket TCK-7007: "Azure backfill without event_time causing snapshot bleed - res-210" assigned to eng-ops.

sam_partners: Partner sent the CSV — rows missing event_time; they admit it was an export mistake. They ask for a credit instead of invoice reissue.

zoe_finance: Proposed resolution: provisional credit for seats that should belong to next billing period. Quick calc: billed 140 - actual 118 = 22 seats * $36 = $792 credit. Finance approves provisional credit up to $900 pending eng reconciliation.

henry_billing: Agreed. Action items: 1) eng to mark those backfilled rows as "post-snapshot" and exclude from invoice (ingest-bot ticket) 2) finance to issue credit memo and attach to TCK-7007 3) partners to re-send CSV with event_time for proper backfill ingestion.

sam_partners: Partner will resend corrected CSV and confirm they accept the credit.

zoe_finance: I'll place AP hold until TCK-7007 is updated and credit memo is attached. ETA EOD tomorrow.

billing-bot: TCK-7007 updated: "AP hold placed; provisional credit $792".

henry_billing: Recommend adding a validation to reject backfill rows lacking explicit event_time when ingest_time > snapshot_time, with alert to partner. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

zoe_finance: Thanks all — will close once corrected CSV and memo are in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
